proofs.text: Open the regulated fixture, whose payload reports an uncommitted working tree; verify 2 notices are on the board, then open the review list and verify zero notices are on screen

rule_text: The notice that the working tree has uncommitted changes belongs to the board and appears on no other screen

tests.body:
def test_the_working_tree_notice_only_shows_on_the_board(browser, tmp_path):
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('regulated'))
    assert len(page.query_selector_all('.notice')) == 2
    page.click('[data-screen="review"]')
    assert page.query_selector_all('.notice') == []
    page.close()
tests.name: test_the_working_tree_notice_only_shows_on_the_board
